('O(n)', 'O(1)', 'small', 'r0-r7').source:
IN R0           ; R0 = n

    ; Handle base cases
    JZ R0, ZERO     ; if n == 0, output 0
    MOV R1, 1
    JZ R1, ONE      ; never, but placeholder
    ; Check if n == 1
    MOV R2, 1
    SUB R2, R0      ; R2 = 1 - n
    JZ R2, ONE      ; if n == 1, output 1

    ; General case: compute fib(n)
    ; R1 = fib(i-1) = fib(0) = 0
    ; R2 = fib(i)   = fib(1) = 1
    ; R3 = counter, starts at 1, goes up to n-1
    ; R4 = modulus
    MOV R1, 0
    MOV R2, 1
    MOV R3, 1
    MOV R4, 1000000007

LOOP:
    ; Check if R3 >= R0 (i.e., we've done n-1 iterations)
    JGE R3, R0, DONE

    ; R5 = R1 + R2
    MOV R5, R1
    ADD R5, R2
    MOD R5, R4

    ; shift: R1 = R2, R2 = R5
    MOV R1, R2
    MOV R2, R5

    INC R3
    JMP LOOP

DONE:
    OUT R2
    HALT

ZERO:
    OUT 0
    HALT

ONE:
    OUT 1
    HALT

('O(n)', 'O(1)', 'medium', 'r0-r7').source:
; Fibonacci using a "two-steps-at-a-time" loop structure
; with a different register layout than previous solutions.
; R0 = n (input)
; R6 = modulus = 10^9+7
; We keep three consecutive fib values: R1=f(k-1), R2=f(k), R3=f(k+1)
; and advance by 2 each iteration, handling odd/even n separately.

    IN R0
    MOV R6, 1000000007

    ; Base cases
    JZ R0, BASE_ZERO

    MOV R4, 1
    JLE R0, R4, BASE_ONE

    ; n >= 2
    ; Initialize: f(0)=0, f(1)=1, f(2)=1
    ; R1 = f(k-1), R2 = f(k), R3 = f(k+1)
    ; Start at k=1: R1=f(0)=0, R2=f(1)=1, R3=f(2)=1
    MOV R1, 0
    MOV R2, 1
    MOV R3, 1

    ; R5 = remaining steps from index 1 to n (we need n-1 more steps)
    ; We'll track current index in R4, start at 2 (we've computed up to f(2))
    MOV R4, 2

LOOP2:
    ; If R4 >= R0, we're done
    JGE R4, R0, DONE

    ; Advance by 2: compute f(k+2) and f(k+3) from f(k), f(k+1), f(k+2)
    ; But first check if one more step suffices
    MOV R5, R4
    ADD R5, 1
    JGE R5, R0, ONE_MORE

    ; Two steps:
    ; f(k+2) = f(k) + f(k+1)  -- R3 already is f(k+1), R2=f(k-1)... wait
    ; Let me restate: after each iteration, R1=f(k-1), R2=f(k), R3=f(k+1)
    ; Step 1: new values: f(k), f(k+1), f(k+2)=f(k)+f(k+1)
    MOV R7, R2
    ADD R7, R3
    MOD R7, R6
    ; Now R1=f(k-1)->discard, R2=f(k), R3=f(k+1), R7=f(k+2)
    ; Step 2: f(k+1), f(k+2), f(k+3)=f(k+1)+f(k+2)
    MOV R1, R3
    ADD R1, R7
    MOD R1, R6
    ; Shift: R1=f(k+1), R2=f(k+2), R3=f(k+3)... wait need to reassign
    ; R_new1 = R3 (f(k+1)), R_new2 = R7 (f(k+2)), R_new3 = R1 (f(k+3))
    ; Use temp: R1 currently holds f(k+3)
    ; We need: R1=f(k+1), R2=f(k+2), R3=f(k+3)
    MOV R5, R1      ; R5 = f(k+3)
    MOV R1, R3      ; R1 = f(k+1)
    MOV R2, R7      ; R2 = f(k+2)
    MOV R3, R5      ; R3 = f(k+3)
    ADD R4, 2
    JMP LOOP2

ONE_MORE:
    ; One step: compute f(k+2) = f(k) + f(k+1) -- but R3=f(k+1), R2=f(k)
    ; Actually current state: R1=f(k-1), R2=f(k), R3=f(k+1), R4=k+1
    ; We need f(R4+1) = f(k+1) + f(k+2)? No.
    ; Current index is R4 meaning we have f(R4) = R3
    ; We need f(R4+1) = R2 + R3... wait
    ; R4 is the index of R3. So f(R4) = R3, f(R4-1) = R2.
    ; f(R4+1) = R2 + R3
    MOV R5, R2
    ADD R5, R3
    MOD R5, R6
    OUT R5
    HALT

DONE:
    ; R4 == R0, answer is R3 = f(R4) = f(n)
    OUT R3
    HALT

BASE_ZERO:
    OUT 0
    HALT

BASE_ONE:
    OUT 1
    HALT

('O(n)', 'O(n)', 'medium', 'r0-r7').source:
IN R0               ; R0 = n
    MOV R6, 1000000007  ; modulus

    ; Store fib values in memory: mem[i] = fib(i)
    ; mem[0] = 0
    MOV R1, 0
    STOR R1, [R1+0]     ; mem[0] = 0

    ; If n == 0, done
    JZ R0, OUTPUT

    ; mem[1] = 1
    MOV R2, 1
    STOR R2, [R2+0]     ; mem[1] = 1

    ; If n == 1, done
    MOV R3, 1
    JLE R0, R3, OUTPUT

    ; Fill mem[2..n] using mem[i] = mem[i-1] + mem[i-2]
    ; R4 = current index i, starts at 2
    MOV R4, 2

FILL:
    JGT R4, R0, OUTPUT  ; if i > n, stop

    ; Load mem[i-1] and mem[i-2]
    MOV R5, R4
    SUB R5, 1
    LOAD R2, [R5+0]     ; R2 = mem[i-1]

    MOV R5, R4
    SUB R5, 2
    LOAD R1, [R5+0]     ; R1 = mem[i-2]

    ; Compute fib(i) = fib(i-1) + fib(i-2) mod MOD
    MOV R3, R1
    ADD R3, R2
    MOD R3, R6

    ; Store mem[i] = R3
    STOR R3, [R4+0]

    INC R4
    JMP FILL

OUTPUT:
    ; Load mem[n] and output
    LOAD R5, [R0+0]
    OUT R5
    HALT

('O(n)', 'O(1)', 'large', 'r0-r7').source:
; Fibonacci: compute fib(n) mod 10^9+7
; Algorithm: unroll loop by 4 - process 4 steps per iteration
; R0 = n (input)
; R1 = fib(k)   (current)
; R2 = fib(k+1)
; R3 = fib(k+2)
; R4 = fib(k+3)
; R5 = modulus
; R6 = index tracker (how many fibs computed beyond fib(1))
; R7 = temp

    IN R0
    MOV R5, 1000000007

    JZ R0, DONE_ZERO

    MOV R7, 1
    JLE R0, R7, DONE_ONE

    MOV R7, 2
    JLE R0, R7, DONE_ONE   ; fib(2) = 1

    ; n >= 3
    ; Start with fib(0)=0, fib(1)=1, fib(2)=1, fib(3)=2
    MOV R1, 0
    MOV R2, 1
    MOV R3, 1
    MOV R7, R2
    ADD R7, R3
    MOD R7, R5
    MOV R4, R7             ; R4 = fib(3) = 2

    ; R6 = current highest index computed = 3
    MOV R6, 3

    ; Check if n <= 3
    JLE R0, R6, PICK_RESULT

LOOP4:
    ; We have fib(k), fib(k+1), fib(k+2), fib(k+3) in R1,R2,R3,R4
    ; Check if we can do 4 more steps (need index+4 <= n)
    MOV R7, R6
    ADD R7, 4
    JGT R7, R0, REMAINDER

    ; Step 1: fib(k+4) = fib(k+2) + fib(k+3)
    MOV R1, R3
    ADD R1, R4
    MOD R1, R5

    ; Step 2: fib(k+5) = fib(k+3) + fib(k+4)
    MOV R2, R4
    ADD R2, R1
    MOD R2, R5

    ; Step 3: fib(k+6) = fib(k+4) + fib(k+5)
    MOV R3, R1
    ADD R3, R2
    MOD R3, R5

    ; Step 4: fib(k+7) = fib(k+5) + fib(k+6)
    MOV R4, R2
    ADD R4, R3
    MOD R4, R5

    ADD R6, 4
    JLE R0, R6, PICK_RESULT
    JMP LOOP4

REMAINDER:
    ; Do one step at a time until R6 == n
    ; Current state: R1=fib(k), R2=fib(k+1), R3=fib(k+2), R4=fib(k+3)
    ; R6 = k+3

STEP1:
    JLE R0, R6, PICK_RESULT
    ; fib(k+4) = fib(k+2) + fib(k+3)
    MOV R7, R3
    ADD R7, R4
    MOD R7, R5
    MOV R1, R2
    MOV R2, R3
    MOV R3, R4
    MOV R4, R7
    INC R6
    JMP STEP1

PICK_RESULT:
    ; R6 = highest index, R0 = n
    ; R1=fib(k), R2=fib(k+1), R3=fib(k+2), R4=fib(k+3)
    ; where k = R6-3
    ; Determine which register holds fib(n)
    MOV R7, R6
    SUB R7, 3
    ; if n == R7 => fib(n) = R1
    MOV R7, R6
    SUB R7, R0
    ; R7 = R6 - n: 0=>R4, 1=>R3, 2=>R2, 3=>R1
    JZ R7, OUT_R4
    MOV R7, R6
    SUB R7, R0
    SUB R7, 1
    JZ R7, OUT_R3
    MOV R7, R6
    SUB R7, R0
    SUB R7, 2
    JZ R7, OUT_R2
    OUT R1
    HALT

OUT_R4:
    OUT R4
    HALT

OUT_R3:
    OUT R3
    HALT

OUT_R2:
    OUT R2
    HALT

DONE_ZERO:
    OUT 0
    HALT

DONE_ONE:
    OUT 1
    HALT

('O(log n)', 'O(log n)', 'medium', 'r0-r.source:
; Fibonacci using matrix exponentiation (iterative doubling method)
; fib(2k)   = fib(k) * (2*fib(k+1) - fib(k))
; fib(2k+1) = fib(k)^2 + fib(k+1)^2
; This is O(log n) time, fundamentally different from all iterative O(n) solutions above.
;
; We store the "stack" of bits of n in memory, then process from MSB to LSB.
; R0 = n
; R1 = a = fib(k)
; R2 = b = fib(k+1)
; R3 = modulus
; R4 = temp / bit storage pointer
; R5 = temp
; R6 = temp
; R7 = temp

    IN R0
    MOV R3, 1000000007

    ; Base cases
    JZ R0, OUT_ZERO
    MOV R5, 1
    JLE R0, R5, OUT_ONE

    ; Store bits of n (LSB first) in mem[0], mem[1], ...
    ; We'll read them back MSB first
    MOV R4, 0          ; bit count / index
    MOV R7, R0         ; working copy of n

BIT_EXTRACT:
    JZ R7, BITS_DONE
    ; bit = R7 % 2
    MOV R5, R7
    MOD R5, 2
    STOR R5, [R4+0]    ; store bit
    INC R4
    DIV R7, 2
    JMP BIT_EXTRACT

BITS_DONE:
    ; R4 = number of bits stored
    ; Now process from MSB (index R4-1) down to 0
    ; Initialize: a=fib(0)=0, b=fib(1)=1
    MOV R1, 0
    MOV R2, 1

    ; Start from MSB: index = R4-1
    DEC R4

DOUBLING_LOOP:
    ; Load bit at mem[R4]
    LOAD R5, [R4+0]    ; R5 = current bit

    ; Doubling step:
    ; c = a*(2b - a) mod MOD
    ; d = a*a + b*b mod MOD
    ; new a = c, new b = d

    ; Compute 2*b - a
    MOV R6, R2
    MUL R6, 2
    SUB R6, R1
    MOD R6, R3

    ; c = a * (2b - a) mod MOD
    MOV R7, R1
    MUL R7, R6
    MOD R7, R3         ; R7 = c = fib(2k)

    ; d = a*a + b*b mod MOD
    MOV R6, R1
    MUL R6, R1
    MOD R6, R3
    MOV R1, R2
    MUL R1, R2
    MOD R1, R3
    ADD R6, R1
    MOD R6, R3         ; R6 = d = fib(2k+1)

    ; Now a = c, b = d
    MOV R1, R7
    MOV R2, R6

    ; If bit == 1: advance one step
    ; fib(2k+1) = R2 (already), fib(2k+2) = R1 + R2
    JZ R5, NO_ADVANCE
    MOV R5, R1
    ADD R5, R2
    MOD R5, R3
    MOV R1, R2
    MOV R2, R5

NO_ADVANCE:
    ; Next bit
    JZ R4, LOOP_END
    DEC R4
    JMP DOUBLING_LOOP

LOOP_END:
    OUT R1
    HALT

OUT_ZERO:
    OUT 0
    HALT

OUT_ONE:
    OUT 1
    HALT

('O(n\u00b2)', 'O(n\u00b2)', 'large', 'r.source:
; Fibonacci mod 10^9+7 using explicit recursion simulation with a memory stack
; Mimics: fib(n) = fib(n-1) + fib(n-2) with memoization in mem[n]
; Stack frames stored in mem[1000+] to avoid collision with memo table
; mem[0..999] = memo table (0 = not computed, except fib(0)=0 is special)
; mem[500] = sentinel: 1 means mem[0] initialized
; We use an explicit stack to simulate recursion:
;   push (n, return_addr) onto stack, process iteratively
;
; Actually: use memoized iterative DFS via explicit stack
; Stack grows from mem[2000] upward
; Each frame: mem[SP] = n to compute, mem[SP+1] = phase (0=first visit,1=return)
;
; R0 = n (input)
; R1 = modulus = 1000000007
; R2 = stack pointer (index into mem)
; R3 = temp
; R4 = temp
; R5 = temp
; R6 = temp
; R7 = temp

    IN R0
    MOV R1, 1000000007

    ; Initialize memo table: use mem[1000] as "fib(0) stored" flag
    ; We'll store fib values in mem[i] for i=0..n
    ; Problem: mem[0]=0 by default, same as fib(0)=0, ambiguous
    ; Solution: store fib(i)+1 in memo, 0 means not computed
    ; So memo[i] = fib(i)+1 if computed, 0 if not

    ; Initialize SP at 2000
    MOV R2, 2000

    ; Push initial call: compute fib(R0)
    ; Frame: [n, phase]
    STOR R0, [R2+0]
    MOV R3, 0
    STOR R3, [R2+1]
    ADD R2, 2

MAIN_LOOP:
    ; If stack empty (SP == 2000), we're done
    MOV R3, 2000
    JLE R2, R3, STACK_EMPTY

    ; Peek top frame: SP-2 = n, SP-1 = phase
    MOV R4, R2
    SUB R4, 2
    LOAD R5, [R4+0]    ; R5 = n for this frame
    LOAD R6, [R4+1]    ; R6 = phase

    ; Check if already memoized
    LOAD R7, [R5+0]    ; R7 = memo[n]
    JNZ R7, MEMOIZED

    ; Not memoized
    ; Base case n=0: fib(0)=0, memo=1
    JZ R5, BASE_ZERO_FRAME

    ; Base case n=1: fib(1)=1, memo=2
    MOV R3, 1
    JLE R5, R3, BASE_ONE_FRAME

    ; n >= 2, check phase
    JNZ R6, PHASE_ONE

    ; Phase 0: first visit
    ; Set phase=1 in current frame
    MOV R3, 1
    STOR R3, [R4+1]

    ; Push call for fib(n-1)
    MOV R3, R5
    SUB R3, 1
    STOR R3, [R2+0]
    MOV R7, 0
    STOR R7, [R2+1]
    ADD R2, 2
    JMP MAIN_LOOP

PHASE_ONE:
    ; fib(n-1) should be computed now, push fib(n-2)
    ; Check if fib(n-2) is computed
    MOV R3, R5
    SUB R3, 2
    LOAD R7, [R3+0]    ; memo[n-2]
    JNZ R7, BOTH_READY

    ; Need to compute fib(n-2): push it
    ; Set phase=2 in current frame
    MOV R3, 2
    STOR R3, [R4+1]

    MOV R3, R5
    SUB R3, 2
    STOR R3, [R2+0]
    MOV R7, 0
    STOR R7, [R2+1]
    ADD R2, 2
    JMP MAIN_LOOP

BOTH_READY:
    ; Both fib(n-1) and fib(n-2) are memoized
    ; fib(n) = (memo[n-1]-1) + (memo[n-2]-1) mod MOD
    MOV R3, R5
    SUB R3, 1
    LOAD R6, [R3+0]    ; memo[n-1]
    SUB R6, 1          ; fib(n-1)

    MOV R3, R5
    SUB R3, 2
    LOAD R7, [R3+0]    ; memo[n-2]
    SUB R7, 1          ; fib(n-2)

    ADD R6, R7
    MOD R6, R1         ; fib(n)

    ; Store memo[n] = fib(n)+1
    MOV R7, R6
    ADD R7, 1
    STOR R7, [R5+0]

    ; Pop this frame
    SUB R2, 2
    JMP MAIN_LOOP

MEMOIZED:
    ; memo[n] = R7, fib(n) = R7-1
    ; Pop frame
    SUB R2, 2
    JMP MAIN_LOOP

BASE_ZERO_FRAME:
    ; fib(0) = 0, memo[0] = 1
    MOV R3, 1
    STOR R3, [R5+0]
    SUB R2, 2
    JMP MAIN_LOOP

BASE_ONE_FRAME:
    ; fib(1) = 1, memo[1] = 2
    MOV R3, 2
    STOR R3, [R5+0]
    SUB R2, 2
    JMP MAIN_LOOP

STACK_EMPTY:
    ; Result is memo[R0] - 1
    LOAD R3, [R0+0]
    SUB R3, 1
    OUT R3
    HALT

('O(log n)', 'O(1)', 'medium', 'r0-r7').source:
; Fibonacci mod 10^9+7
; Algorithm: Fast doubling, iterative, MSB-first using a bitmask
; that starts at highest power-of-2 <= n and shifts right each step.
; No memory used, no bit stack - just a bitmask register.
; R0 = n
; R1 = a = fib(k)
; R2 = b = fib(k+1)
; R3 = modulus
; R4 = bitmask (starts at highest power of 2 <= n, shifts right)
; R5,R6,R7 = temporaries

    IN R0
    MOV R3, 1000000007

    JZ R0, OUT_ZERO
    MOV R5, 1
    JLE R0, R5, OUT_ONE

    ; Find highest power of 2 <= n
    ; Start mask at 1, double while mask*2 <= n
    MOV R4, 1

FIND_MSB:
    MOV R5, R4
    MUL R5, 2
    JGT R5, R0, MSB_FOUND
    MOV R4, R5
    JMP FIND_MSB

MSB_FOUND:
    ; R4 = highest power of 2 <= n
    ; Initialize a=fib(0)=0, b=fib(1)=1
    MOV R1, 0
    MOV R2, 1

DOUBLE_LOOP:
    ; Fast doubling step:
    ; c = a*(2b - a) mod MOD  => fib(2k)
    ; d = a^2 + b^2 mod MOD   => fib(2k+1)

    ; Compute 2*b - a, store in R5
    MOV R5, R2
    MUL R5, 2
    SUB R5, R1
    MOD R5, R3

    ; c = a * R5 mod MOD => R6
    MOV R6, R1
    MUL R6, R5
    MOD R6, R3

    ; d = a*a + b*b mod MOD => R7
    MOV R7, R1
    MUL R7, R1
    MOD R7, R3
    MOV R5, R2
    MUL R5, R2
    MOD R5, R3
    ADD R7, R5
    MOD R7, R3

    ; a = c, b = d
    MOV R1, R6
    MOV R2, R7

    ; Check if current bit of n (via mask R4) is set
    ; bit set if (n AND mask) != 0, i.e., n >= mask AND (n - mask) < mask*2... 
    ; simpler: use MOD and DIV: bit = (n / mask) % 2
    MOV R5, R0
    DIV R5, R4
    MOD R5, 2
    JZ R5, BIT_ZERO

    ; Bit is 1: advance one step
    ; fib(2k+1) = b (already), fib(2k+2) = a+b
    MOV R5, R1
    ADD R5, R2
    MOD R5, R3
    MOV R1, R2
    MOV R2, R5

BIT_ZERO:
    ; Shift mask right by 1 (divide by 2)
    DIV R4, 2
    JZ R4, DONE
    JMP DOUBLE_LOOP

DONE:
    OUT R1
    HALT

OUT_ZERO:
    OUT 0
    HALT

OUT_ONE:
    OUT 1
    HALT

('O(log n)', 'O(log n)', 'large', 'r0-r7.source:
; Fibonacci mod 10^9+7
; Algorithm: Fast doubling, LSB-first bit processing.
; We extract bits of n from LSB to MSB into a memory array,
; then process MSB-to-LSB using those stored bits.
; Structurally distinct: bit extraction separate from doubling,
; bits stored in memory high-to-low, processed with a second pointer scan.
;
; R0 = n
; R1 = modulus
; R2 = bit extraction working copy of n
; R3 = write pointer for bit array (grows upward from mem[100])
; R4 = read pointer (scans downward from top)
; R5, R6, R7 = temporaries
; R1 = a = fib(k) during doubling phase (reused)
; After bit extraction: R1=modulus saved in mem[99]

    IN R0
    MOV R1, 1000000007

    JZ R0, OUT_ZERO
    MOV R5, 1
    JLE R0, R5, OUT_ONE

    ; Save modulus in mem[99]
    STOR R1, [R1-999999908]  ; can't do this easily, use R3
    MOV R3, 99
    STOR R1, [R3+0]          ; mem[99] = modulus

    ; Extract bits of n, LSB first, store in mem[100], mem[101], ...
    MOV R2, R0               ; working copy
    MOV R3, 100              ; write pointer

EXTRACT:
    JZ R2, EXTRACT_DONE
    MOV R5, R2
    MOD R5, 2                ; LSB
    STOR R5, [R3+0]          ; store bit
    INC R3
    DIV R2, 2
    JMP EXTRACT

EXTRACT_DONE:
    ; R3 now points one past last bit written
    ; Bits are in mem[100..R3-1], LSB at mem[100], MSB at mem[R3-1]
    ; Process MSB first: start read pointer at R3-1, go down to 100

    ; Initialize fast doubling: a=fib(0)=0, b=fib(1)=1
    ; Store in mem[97]=a, mem[98]=b
    MOV R4, 97
    MOV R5, 0
    STOR R5, [R4+0]          ; mem[97] = a = 0
    MOV R5, 1
    STOR R5, [R4+1]          ; mem[98] = b = 1

    ; Read pointer starts at MSB = mem[R3-1]
    DEC R3                   ; R3 = index of MSB bit

DOUBLE_LOOP:
    ; Load a from mem[97], b from mem[98]
    MOV R4, 97
    LOAD R5, [R4+0]          ; R5 = a
    LOAD R6, [R4+1]          ; R6 = b
    LOAD R1, [R4+2]          ; R1 = modulus from mem[99]

    ; Fast doubling:
    ; c = a*(2b - a) mod MOD
    ; d = a*a + b*b mod MOD

    MOV R7, R6
    MUL R7, 2
    SUB R7, R5
    MOD R7, R1               ; R7 = 2b - a

    ; c = a * (2b-a) mod MOD
    MUL R5, R7
    MOD R5, R1               ; R5 = c = fib(2k)

    ; d = a*a + b*b: reload a and b
    MOV R4, 97
    LOAD R6, [R4+0]          ; R6 = a (original)
    LOAD R7, [R4+1]          ; R7 = b (original)
    LOAD R1, [R4+2]          ; modulus

    MUL R6, R6
    MOD R6, R1
    MUL R7, R7
    MOD R7, R1
    ADD R6, R7

; Fibonacci using a "two-steps-at-a-time" loop structure
; with a different register layout than previous solutions.
; R0 = n (input)
; R6 = modulus = 10^9+7
; We keep three consecutive fib values: R1=f(k-1), R2=f(k), R3=f(k+1)
; and advance by 2 each iteration, handling odd/even n separately.

    IN R0
    MOV R6, 1000000007

    ; Base cases
    JZ R0, BASE_ZERO

    MOV R4, 1
    JLE R0, R4, BASE_ONE

    ; n >= 2
    ; Initialize: f(0)=0, f(1)=1, f(2)=1
    ; R1 = f(k-1), R2 = f(k), R3 = f(k+1)
    ; Start at k=1: R1=f(0)=0, R2=f(1)=1, R3=f(2)=1
    MOV R1, 0
    MOV R2, 1
    MOV R3, 1

    ; R5 = remaining steps from index 1 to n (we need n-1 more steps)
    ; We'll track current index in R4, start at 2 (we've computed up to f(2))
    MOV R4, 2

LOOP2:
    ; If R4 >= R0, we're done
    JGE R4, R0, DONE

    ; Advance by 2: compute f(k+2) and f(k+3) from f(k), f(k+1), f(k+2)
    ; But first check if one more step suffices
    MOV R5, R4
    ADD R5, 1
    JGE R5, R0, ONE_MORE

    ; Two steps:
    ; f(k+2) = f(k) + f(k+1)  -- R3 already is f(k+1), R2=f(k-1)... wait
    ; Let me restate: after each iteration, R1=f(k-1), R2=f(k), R3=f(k+1)
    ; Step 1: new values: f(k), f(k+1), f(k+2)=f(k)+f(k+1)
    MOV R7, R2
    ADD R7, R3
    MOD R7, R6
    ; Now R1=f(k-1)->discard, R2=f(k), R3=f(k+1), R7=f(k+2)
    ; Step 2: f(k+1), f(k+2), f(k+3)=f(k+1)+f(k+2)
    MOV R1, R3
    ADD R1, R7
    MOD R1, R6
    ; Shift: R1=f(k+1), R2=f(k+2), R3=f(k+3)... wait need to reassign
    ; R_new1 = R3 (f(k+1)), R_new2 = R7 (f(k+2)), R_new3 = R1 (f(k+3))
    ; Use temp: R1 currently holds f(k+3)
    ; We need: R1=f(k+1), R2=f(k+2), R3=f(k+3)
    MOV R5, R1      ; R5 = f(k+3)
    MOV R1, R3      ; R1 = f(k+1)
    MOV R2, R7      ; R2 = f(k+2)
    MOV R3, R5      ; R3 = f(k+3)
    ADD R4, 2
    JMP LOOP2

ONE_MORE:
    ; One step: compute f(k+2) = f(k) + f(k+1) -- but R3=f(k+1), R2=f(k)
    ; Actually current state: R1=f(k-1), R2=f(k), R3=f(k+1), R4=k+1
    ; We need f(R4+1) = f(k+1) + f(k+2)? No.
    ; Current index is R4 meaning we have f(R4) = R3
    ; We need f(R4+1) = R2 + R3... wait
    ; R4 is the index of R3. So f(R4) = R3, f(R4-1) = R2.
    ; f(R4+1) = R2 + R3
    MOV R5, R2
    ADD R5, R3
    MOD R5, R6
    OUT R5
    HALT

DONE:
    ; R4 == R0, answer is R3 = f(R4) = f(n)
    OUT R3
    HALT

BASE_ZERO:
    OUT 0
    HALT

BASE_ONE:
    OUT 1
    HALT

IN R0               ; R0 = n
    MOV R6, 1000000007  ; modulus

    ; Store fib values in memory: mem[i] = fib(i)
    ; mem[0] = 0
    MOV R1, 0
    STOR R1, [R1+0]     ; mem[0] = 0

    ; If n == 0, done
    JZ R0, OUTPUT

    ; mem[1] = 1
    MOV R2, 1
    STOR R2, [R2+0]     ; mem[1] = 1

    ; If n == 1, done
    MOV R3, 1
    JLE R0, R3, OUTPUT

    ; Fill mem[2..n] using mem[i] = mem[i-1] + mem[i-2]
    ; R4 = current index i, starts at 2
    MOV R4, 2

FILL:
    JGT R4, R0, OUTPUT  ; if i > n, stop

    ; Load mem[i-1] and mem[i-2]
    MOV R5, R4
    SUB R5, 1
    LOAD R2, [R5+0]     ; R2 = mem[i-1]

    MOV R5, R4
    SUB R5, 2
    LOAD R1, [R5+0]     ; R1 = mem[i-2]

    ; Compute fib(i) = fib(i-1) + fib(i-2) mod MOD
    MOV R3, R1
    ADD R3, R2
    MOD R3, R6

    ; Store mem[i] = R3
    STOR R3, [R4+0]

    INC R4
    JMP FILL

OUTPUT:
    ; Load mem[n] and output
    LOAD R5, [R0+0]
    OUT R5
    HALT

; Fibonacci using a "count-up with a single accumulator swap" approach
; but structured as a DO-WHILE with the loop test at the bottom,
; and using a third register to hold the modulus constant,
; advancing from fib(1),fib(2) toward fib(n).
;
; R0 = n
; R1 = fib(prev) = fib(i-1)
; R2 = fib(curr) = fib(i)
; R3 = modulus
; R4 = loop counter i (starts at 2, goes up to n)
; R5 = temp for new fib value

    IN R0
    MOV R3, 1000000007

    ; fib(0) = 0
    JZ R0, EMIT_ZERO

    ; fib(1) = 1
    MOV R5, 1
    JLE R0, R5, EMIT_ONE

    ; n >= 2: initialize
    ; R1 = fib(0) = 0, R2 = fib(1) = 1, counter i = 2
    MOV R1, 0
    MOV R2, 1
    MOV R4, 2

ITER:
    ; R5 = fib(i) = fib(i-1) + fib(i-2) mod MOD
    MOV R5, R1
    ADD R5, R2
    MOD R5, R3

    ; Advance: R1 = R2, R2 = R5
    MOV R1, R2
    MOV R2, R5

    ; i++
    INC R4

    ; if i <= n, keep going
    JLE R4, R0, ITER

    ; done: answer is R2 = fib(n)
    OUT R2
    HALT

EMIT_ZERO:
    OUT 0
    HALT

EMIT_ONE:
    OUT 1
    HALT

; Fibonacci: compute fib(n) mod 10^9+7
; Algorithm: unroll loop by 4 - process 4 steps per iteration
; R0 = n (input)
; R1 = fib(k)   (current)
; R2 = fib(k+1)
; R3 = fib(k+2)
; R4 = fib(k+3)
; R5 = modulus
; R6 = index tracker (how many fibs computed beyond fib(1))
; R7 = temp

    IN R0
    MOV R5, 1000000007

    JZ R0, DONE_ZERO

    MOV R7, 1
    JLE R0, R7, DONE_ONE

    MOV R7, 2
    JLE R0, R7, DONE_ONE   ; fib(2) = 1

    ; n >= 3
    ; Start with fib(0)=0, fib(1)=1, fib(2)=1, fib(3)=2
    MOV R1, 0
    MOV R2, 1
    MOV R3, 1
    MOV R7, R2
    ADD R7, R3
    MOD R7, R5
    MOV R4, R7             ; R4 = fib(3) = 2

    ; R6 = current highest index computed = 3
    MOV R6, 3

    ; Check if n <= 3
    JLE R0, R6, PICK_RESULT

LOOP4:
    ; We have fib(k), fib(k+1), fib(k+2), fib(k+3) in R1,R2,R3,R4
    ; Check if we can do 4 more steps (need index+4 <= n)
    MOV R7, R6
    ADD R7, 4
    JGT R7, R0, REMAINDER

    ; Step 1: fib(k+4) = fib(k+2) + fib(k+3)
    MOV R1, R3
    ADD R1, R4
    MOD R1, R5

    ; Step 2: fib(k+5) = fib(k+3) + fib(k+4)
    MOV R2, R4
    ADD R2, R1
    MOD R2, R5

    ; Step 3: fib(k+6) = fib(k+4) + fib(k+5)
    MOV R3, R1
    ADD R3, R2
    MOD R3, R5

    ; Step 4: fib(k+7) = fib(k+5) + fib(k+6)
    MOV R4, R2
    ADD R4, R3
    MOD R4, R5

    ADD R6, 4
    JLE R0, R6, PICK_RESULT
    JMP LOOP4

REMAINDER:
    ; Do one step at a time until R6 == n
    ; Current state: R1=fib(k), R2=fib(k+1), R3=fib(k+2), R4=fib(k+3)
    ; R6 = k+3

STEP1:
    JLE R0, R6, PICK_RESULT
    ; fib(k+4) = fib(k+2) + fib(k+3)
    MOV R7, R3
    ADD R7, R4
    MOD R7, R5
    MOV R1, R2
    MOV R2, R3
    MOV R3, R4
    MOV R4, R7
    INC R6
    JMP STEP1

PICK_RESULT:
    ; R6 = highest index, R0 = n
    ; R1=fib(k), R2=fib(k+1), R3=fib(k+2), R4=fib(k+3)
    ; where k = R6-3
    ; Determine which register holds fib(n)
    MOV R7, R6
    SUB R7, 3
    ; if n == R7 => fib(n) = R1
    MOV R7, R6
    SUB R7, R0
    ; R7 = R6 - n: 0=>R4, 1=>R3, 2=>R2, 3=>R1
    JZ R7, OUT_R4
    MOV R7, R6
    SUB R7, R0
    SUB R7, 1
    JZ R7, OUT_R3
    MOV R7, R6
    SUB R7, R0
    SUB R7, 2
    JZ R7, OUT_R2
    OUT R1
    HALT

OUT_R4:
    OUT R4
    HALT

OUT_R3:
    OUT R3
    HALT

OUT_R2:
    OUT R2
    HALT

DONE_ZERO:
    OUT 0
    HALT

DONE_ONE:
    OUT 1
    HALT

; Fibonacci using a countdown loop (n down to 0) with swapped register roles
; Fundamentally different: counts DOWN from n to 0, uses MOV+ADD in reverse order
; R0 = n (input), counts down to 0
; R1 = "future" fib value (starts as fib(n) conceptually built up)
; R2 = modulus
; R3 = a = fib(0) = 0
; R4 = b = fib(1) = 1
; We iterate n times: each step computes next fib, decrement counter

    IN R0
    MOV R2, 1000000007

    ; Special case n=0
    JZ R0, OUT_ZERO

    ; Special case n=1
    MOV R5, 1
    JLE R0, R5, OUT_ONE

    ; General: n >= 2
    ; We'll count down: R0 goes from n to 1
    ; R3 = fib(i-1), R4 = fib(i), compute fib(i+1) = R3+R4
    ; Start: R3=fib(0)=0, R4=fib(1)=1, counter=n-1 steps needed
    MOV R3, 0
    MOV R4, 1
    ; We need n-1 more steps to get fib(n)
    DEC R0   ; R0 = n-1

COUNTDOWN:
    ; R5 = fib(i+1) = R3 + R4 mod MOD
    MOV R5, R3
    ADD R5, R4
    MOD R5, R2

    ; Shift: R3 = R4, R4 = R5
    MOV R3, R4
    MOV R4, R5

    DEC R0
    JNZ R0, COUNTDOWN

    ; R4 = fib(n)
    OUT R4
    HALT

OUT_ZERO:
    OUT 0
    HALT

OUT_ONE:
    OUT 1
    HALT

; Fibonacci using matrix exponentiation (iterative doubling method)
; fib(2k)   = fib(k) * (2*fib(k+1) - fib(k))
; fib(2k+1) = fib(k)^2 + fib(k+1)^2
; This is O(log n) time, fundamentally different from all iterative O(n) solutions above.
;
; We store the "stack" of bits of n in memory, then process from MSB to LSB.
; R0 = n
; R1 = a = fib(k)
; R2 = b = fib(k+1)
; R3 = modulus
; R4 = temp / bit storage pointer
; R5 = temp
; R6 = temp
; R7 = temp

    IN R0
    MOV R3, 1000000007

    ; Base cases
    JZ R0, OUT_ZERO
    MOV R5, 1
    JLE R0, R5, OUT_ONE

    ; Store bits of n (LSB first) in mem[0], mem[1], ...
    ; We'll read them back MSB first
    MOV R4, 0          ; bit count / index
    MOV R7, R0         ; working copy of n

BIT_EXTRACT:
    JZ R7, BITS_DONE
    ; bit = R7 % 2
    MOV R5, R7
    MOD R5, 2
    STOR R5, [R4+0]    ; store bit
    INC R4
    DIV R7, 2
    JMP BIT_EXTRACT

BITS_DONE:
    ; R4 = number of bits stored
    ; Now process from MSB (index R4-1) down to 0
    ; Initialize: a=fib(0)=0, b=fib(1)=1
    MOV R1, 0
    MOV R2, 1

    ; Start from MSB: index = R4-1
    DEC R4

DOUBLING_LOOP:
    ; Load bit at mem[R4]
    LOAD R5, [R4+0]    ; R5 = current bit

    ; Doubling step:
    ; c = a*(2b - a) mod MOD
    ; d = a*a + b*b mod MOD
    ; new a = c, new b = d

    ; Compute 2*b - a
    MOV R6, R2
    MUL R6, 2
    SUB R6, R1
    MOD R6, R3

    ; c = a * (2b - a) mod MOD
    MOV R7, R1
    MUL R7, R6
    MOD R7, R3         ; R7 = c = fib(2k)

    ; d = a*a + b*b mod MOD
    MOV R6, R1
    MUL R6, R1
    MOD R6, R3
    MOV R1, R2
    MUL R1, R2
    MOD R1, R3
    ADD R6, R1
    MOD R6, R3         ; R6 = d = fib(2k+1)

    ; Now a = c, b = d
    MOV R1, R7
    MOV R2, R6

    ; If bit == 1: advance one step
    ; fib(2k+1) = R2 (already), fib(2k+2) = R1 + R2
    JZ R5, NO_ADVANCE
    MOV R5, R1
    ADD R5, R2
    MOD R5, R3
    MOV R1, R2
    MOV R2, R5

NO_ADVANCE:
    ; Next bit
    JZ R4, LOOP_END
    DEC R4
    JMP DOUBLING_LOOP

LOOP_END:
    OUT R1
    HALT

OUT_ZERO:
    OUT 0
    HALT

OUT_ONE:
    OUT 1
    HALT

; Fibonacci mod 10^9+7 using a circular buffer of size 3 in memory
; mem[0], mem[1], mem[2] hold three consecutive fib values
; A write pointer cycles 0->1->2->0->...
; R0 = n
; R1 = modulus
; R2 = write pointer (0,1,2)
; R3 = loop counter
; R4 = temp: index of oldest value (write+0 mod 3 after write)
; R5, R6 = temps

    IN R0
    MOV R1, 1000000007

    ; Handle n=0
    JZ R0, EMIT_ZERO

    ; Handle n=1 or n=2
    MOV R5, 2
    JLE R0, R5, EMIT_ONE

    ; Initialize circular buffer:
    ; mem[0] = fib(0) = 0
    ; mem[1] = fib(1) = 1
    ; mem[2] = fib(2) = 1
    MOV R5, 0
    STOR R5, [R5+0]     ; mem[0] = 0
    MOV R5, 1
    STOR R5, [R5+0]     ; mem[1] = 1
    STOR R5, [R5+1]     ; mem[2] = 1

    ; R2 = write pointer: next slot to overwrite = 0 (holds fib(0), oldest)
    ; After writing fib(3), pointer advances to 1, etc.
    ; Current state: buf has fib(0),fib(1),fib(2), pointer=0 (fib(0) is oldest)
    ; We've computed up to index 2. Need to reach index n.
    ; R3 = current highest index in buffer = 2
    MOV R3, 2
    MOV R2, 0           ; write pointer (slot to overwrite next)

LOOP:
    ; If R3 >= R0, we have fib(n) in buffer
    JGE R3, R0, FIND_RESULT

    ; Compute fib(R3+1) = fib(R3) + fib(R3-1)
    ; The two newest values are at slots (R2+2)%3 and (R2+1)%3
    ; (R2+1)%3 = second newest = fib(R3-1)
    ; (R2+2)%3 = newest = fib(R3)
    MOV R4, R2
    ADD R4, 2

    ; Advance write pointer
    INC R2
    MOD R2, 3

    INC R3

FIND_RESULT:

    ; fib(n) is in slot (R2+2)%3 (the newest written slot)
    MOV R4, R2
    ADD R4, 2
    MOD R4, 3

EMIT_ZERO:

; Fibonacci mod 10^9+7
; Algorithm: "ping-pong" between two memory locations
; mem[0] and mem[1] alternate as "current" and "next"
; We use a phase bit to know which slot holds fib(i)
; R0 = n
; R1 = modulus
; R2 = phase (0 or 1): mem[phase] = fib(i), mem[1-phase] = fib(i-1)
; R3 = counter (current index i)
; R4, R5, R6 = temps

    IN R0
    MOV R1, 1000000007

    ; n=0 => 0
    JZ R0, EMIT_ZERO

    ; n=1 => 1
    MOV R4, 1
    JLE R0, R4, EMIT_ONE

    ; n >= 2
    ; Initialize: mem[0]=fib(0)=0, mem[1]=fib(1)=1
    ; phase=1 means mem[1]=fib(1) is current, mem[0]=fib(0) is previous
    MOV R4, 0
    STOR R4, [R4+0]    ; mem[0] = 0
    MOV R4, 1
    STOR R4, [R4+0]    ; mem[1] = 1

    MOV R2, 1          ; phase = 1 (current fib is in mem[1])
    MOV R3, 1          ; current index = 1

PINGPONG:
    ; If current index == n, output mem[phase]
    JGE R3, R0, OUTPUT_PHASE

    ; next_phase = 1 - phase
    MOV R5, 1
    SUB R5, R2         ; R5 = next_phase = 1 - phase

    ; Load fib(i) from mem[phase]
    LOAD R4, [R2+0]    ; R4 = fib(i)

    ; Load fib(i-1) from mem[next_phase]
    LOAD R6, [R5+0]    ; R6 = fib(i-1)

    ; fib(i+1) = fib(i) + fib(i-1) mod MOD
    ADD R4, R6
    MOD R4, R1

    ; Store fib(i+1) into mem[next_phase] (overwrite old fib(i-1))
    STOR R4, [R5+0]

    ; Advance phase to next_phase
    MOV R2, R5

    INC R3
    JMP PINGPONG

OUTPUT_PHASE:
    LOAD R5, [R2+0]
    OUT R5
    HALT

EMIT_ZERO:
    OUT 0
    HALT

EMIT_ONE:
    OUT 1
    HALT

; Fibonacci mod 10^9+7 using explicit recursion simulation with a memory stack
; Mimics: fib(n) = fib(n-1) + fib(n-2) with memoization in mem[n]
; Stack frames stored in mem[1000+] to avoid collision with memo table
; mem[0..999] = memo table (0 = not computed, except fib(0)=0 is special)
; mem[500] = sentinel: 1 means mem[0] initialized
; We use an explicit stack to simulate recursion:
;   push (n, return_addr) onto stack, process iteratively
;
; Actually: use memoized iterative DFS via explicit stack
; Stack grows from mem[2000] upward
; Each frame: mem[SP] = n to compute, mem[SP+1] = phase (0=first visit,1=return)
;
; R0 = n (input)
; R1 = modulus = 1000000007
; R2 = stack pointer (index into mem)
; R3 = temp
; R4 = temp
; R5 = temp
; R6 = temp
; R7 = temp

    IN R0
    MOV R1, 1000000007

    ; Initialize memo table: use mem[1000] as "fib(0) stored" flag
    ; We'll store fib values in mem[i] for i=0..n
    ; Problem: mem[0]=0 by default, same as fib(0)=0, ambiguous
    ; Solution: store fib(i)+1 in memo, 0 means not computed
    ; So memo[i] = fib(i)+1 if computed, 0 if not

    ; Initialize SP at 2000
    MOV R2, 2000

    ; Push initial call: compute fib(R0)
    ; Frame: [n, phase]
    STOR R0, [R2+0]
    MOV R3, 0
    STOR R3, [R2+1]
    ADD R2, 2

MAIN_LOOP:
    ; If stack empty (SP == 2000), we're done
    MOV R3, 2000
    JLE R2, R3, STACK_EMPTY

    ; Peek top frame: SP-2 = n, SP-1 = phase
    MOV R4, R2
    SUB R4, 2
    LOAD R5, [R4+0]    ; R5 = n for this frame
    LOAD R6, [R4+1]    ; R6 = phase

    ; Check if already memoized
    LOAD R7, [R5+0]    ; R7 = memo[n]
    JNZ R7, MEMOIZED

    ; Not memoized
    ; Base case n=0: fib(0)=0, memo=1
    JZ R5, BASE_ZERO_FRAME

    ; Base case n=1: fib(1)=1, memo=2
    MOV R3, 1
    JLE R5, R3, BASE_ONE_FRAME

    ; n >= 2, check phase
    JNZ R6, PHASE_ONE

    ; Phase 0: first visit
    ; Set phase=1 in current frame
    MOV R3, 1
    STOR R3, [R4+1]

    ; Push call for fib(n-1)
    MOV R3, R5
    SUB R3, 1
    STOR R3, [R2+0]
    MOV R7, 0
    STOR R7, [R2+1]
    ADD R2, 2
    JMP MAIN_LOOP

PHASE_ONE:
    ; fib(n-1) should be computed now, push fib(n-2)
    ; Check if fib(n-2) is computed
    MOV R3, R5
    SUB R3, 2
    LOAD R7, [R3+0]    ; memo[n-2]
    JNZ R7, BOTH_READY

    ; Need to compute fib(n-2): push it
    ; Set phase=2 in current frame
    MOV R3, 2
    STOR R3, [R4+1]

    MOV R3, R5
    SUB R3, 2
    STOR R3, [R2+0]
    MOV R7, 0
    STOR R7, [R2+1]
    ADD R2, 2
    JMP MAIN_LOOP

BOTH_READY:
    ; Both fib(n-1) and fib(n-2) are memoized
    ; fib(n) = (memo[n-1]-1) + (memo[n-2]-1) mod MOD
    MOV R3, R5
    SUB R3, 1
    LOAD R6, [R3+0]    ; memo[n-1]
    SUB R6, 1          ; fib(n-1)

    MOV R3, R5
    SUB R3, 2
    LOAD R7, [R3+0]    ; memo[n-2]
    SUB R7, 1          ; fib(n-2)

    ADD R6, R7
    MOD R6, R1         ; fib(n)

    ; Store memo[n] = fib(n)+1
    MOV R7, R6
    ADD R7, 1
    STOR R7, [R5+0]

    ; Pop this frame
    SUB R2, 2
    JMP MAIN_LOOP

MEMOIZED:
    ; memo[n] = R7, fib(n) = R7-1
    ; Pop frame
    SUB R2, 2
    JMP MAIN_LOOP

BASE_ZERO_FRAME:
    ; fib(0) = 0, memo[0] = 1
    MOV R3, 1
    STOR R3, [R5+0]
    SUB R2, 2
    JMP MAIN_LOOP

BASE_ONE_FRAME:
    ; fib(1) = 1, memo[1] = 2
    MOV R3, 2
    STOR R3, [R5+0]
    SUB R2, 2
    JMP MAIN_LOOP

STACK_EMPTY:
    ; Result is memo[R0] - 1
    LOAD R3, [R0+0]
    SUB R3, 1
    OUT R3
    HALT

; Fibonacci mod 10^9+7
; Algorithm: Fast doubling, iterative, MSB-first using a bitmask
; that starts at highest power-of-2 <= n and shifts right each step.
; No memory used, no bit stack - just a bitmask register.
; R0 = n
; R1 = a = fib(k)
; R2 = b = fib(k+1)
; R3 = modulus
; R4 = bitmask (starts at highest power of 2 <= n, shifts right)
; R5,R6,R7 = temporaries

    IN R0
    MOV R3, 1000000007

    JZ R0, OUT_ZERO
    MOV R5, 1
    JLE R0, R5, OUT_ONE

    ; Find highest power of 2 <= n
    ; Start mask at 1, double while mask*2 <= n
    MOV R4, 1

FIND_MSB:
    MOV R5, R4
    MUL R5, 2
    JGT R5, R0, MSB_FOUND
    MOV R4, R5
    JMP FIND_MSB

MSB_FOUND:
    ; R4 = highest power of 2 <= n
    ; Initialize a=fib(0)=0, b=fib(1)=1
    MOV R1, 0
    MOV R2, 1

DOUBLE_LOOP:
    ; Fast doubling step:
    ; c = a*(2b - a) mod MOD  => fib(2k)
    ; d = a^2 + b^2 mod MOD   => fib(2k+1)

    ; Compute 2*b - a, store in R5
    MOV R5, R2
    MUL R5, 2
    SUB R5, R1
    MOD R5, R3

    ; c = a * R5 mod MOD => R6
    MOV R6, R1
    MUL R6, R5
    MOD R6, R3

    ; d = a*a + b*b mod MOD => R7
    MOV R7, R1
    MUL R7, R1
    MOD R7, R3
    MOV R5, R2
    MUL R5, R2
    MOD R5, R3
    ADD R7, R5
    MOD R7, R3

    ; a = c, b = d
    MOV R1, R6
    MOV R2, R7

    ; Check if current bit of n (via mask R4) is set
    ; bit set if (n AND mask) != 0, i.e., n >= mask AND (n - mask) < mask*2... 
    ; simpler: use MOD and DIV: bit = (n / mask) % 2
    MOV R5, R0
    DIV R5, R4
    MOD R5, 2
    JZ R5, BIT_ZERO

    ; Bit is 1: advance one step
    ; fib(2k+1) = b (already), fib(2k+2) = a+b
    MOV R5, R1
    ADD R5, R2
    MOD R5, R3
    MOV R1, R2
    MOV R2, R5

BIT_ZERO:
    ; Shift mask right by 1 (divide by 2)
    DIV R4, 2
    JZ R4, DONE
    JMP DOUBLE_LOOP

DONE:
    OUT R1
    HALT

OUT_ZERO:
    OUT 0
    HALT

OUT_ONE:
    OUT 1
    HALT

; Fibonacci mod 10^9+7
; Algorithm: Fast doubling, LSB-first bit processing.
; We extract bits of n from LSB to MSB into a memory array,
; then process MSB-to-LSB using those stored bits.
; Structurally distinct: bit extraction separate from doubling,
; bits stored in memory high-to-low, processed with a second pointer scan.
;
; R0 = n
; R1 = modulus
; R2 = bit extraction working copy of n
; R3 = write pointer for bit array (grows upward from mem[100])
; R4 = read pointer (scans downward from top)
; R5, R6, R7 = temporaries
; R1 = a = fib(k) during doubling phase (reused)
; After bit extraction: R1=modulus saved in mem[99]

    IN R0
    MOV R1, 1000000007

    JZ R0, OUT_ZERO
    MOV R5, 1
    JLE R0, R5, OUT_ONE

    ; Save modulus in mem[99]
    STOR R1, [R1-999999908]  ; can't do this easily, use R3
    MOV R3, 99
    STOR R1, [R3+0]          ; mem[99] = modulus

    ; Extract bits of n, LSB first, store in mem[100], mem[101], ...
    MOV R2, R0               ; working copy
    MOV R3, 100              ; write pointer

EXTRACT:
    JZ R2, EXTRACT_DONE
    MOV R5, R2
    MOD R5, 2                ; LSB
    STOR R5, [R3+0]          ; store bit
    INC R3
    DIV R2, 2
    JMP EXTRACT

EXTRACT_DONE:
    ; R3 now points one past last bit written
    ; Bits are in mem[100..R3-1], LSB at mem[100], MSB at mem[R3-1]
    ; Process MSB first: start read pointer at R3-1, go down to 100

    ; Initialize fast doubling: a=fib(0)=0, b=fib(1)=1
    ; Store in mem[97]=a, mem[98]=b
    MOV R4, 97
    MOV R5, 0
    STOR R5, [R4+0]          ; mem[97] = a = 0
    MOV R5, 1
    STOR R5, [R4+1]          ; mem[98] = b = 1

    ; Read pointer starts at MSB = mem[R3-1]
    DEC R3                   ; R3 = index of MSB bit

DOUBLE_LOOP:
    ; Load a from mem[97], b from mem[98]
    MOV R4, 97
    LOAD R5, [R4+0]          ; R5 = a
    LOAD R6, [R4+1]          ; R6 = b
    LOAD R1, [R4+2]          ; R1 = modulus from mem[99]

    ; Fast doubling:
    ; c = a*(2b - a) mod MOD
    ; d = a*a + b*b mod MOD

    MOV R7, R6
    MUL R7, 2
    SUB R7, R5
    MOD R7, R1               ; R7 = 2b - a

    ; c = a * (2b-a) mod MOD
    MUL R5, R7
    MOD R5, R1               ; R5 = c = fib(2k)

    ; d = a*a + b*b: reload a and b
    MOV R4, 97
    LOAD R6, [R4+0]          ; R6 = a (original)
    LOAD R7, [R4+1]          ; R7 = b (original)
    LOAD R1, [R4+2]          ; modulus

    MUL R6, R6
    MOD R6, R1
    MUL R7, R7
    MOD R7, R1
    ADD R6, R7
    MOD R6, R1               ; R6 = d = fib(2k+1)

    ; Store new a=c, b=d
    MOV R4, 97
    STOR R5, [R4+0]
    STOR R6, [R4+1]

    ; Check current bit at mem[R3]
    LOAD R7, [R3+0]
    JZ R7, BIT_IS_ZERO

    ; Bit=1: advance: new_a=d, new_b=c+d
    LOAD R5, [R4+0]          ; a=c
    LOAD R6, [R4+1]          ; b=d
    LOAD R1, [R4+2]          ; modulus
    MOV R7, R5
    ADD R7, R6
    MOD R7, R1               ; c+d
    STOR R6, [R4+0]          ; new a = d
    STOR R7, [R4+1]          ; new b = c+d

BIT_IS_ZERO:
    ; Move read pointer toward LSB
    DEC R3
    ; If R3 < 100, done
    MOV R7, 100
    JLT R3, R7, FINISH
    JMP DOUBLE_LOOP

FINISH:
    ; Result is a = mem[97]
    MOV R4, 97
    LOAD R5, [R4+0]
    OUT R5
    HALT

OUT_ZERO:
    OUT 0
    HALT

OUT_ONE:
    OUT 1
    HALT

; Fibonacci mod 10^9+7
; Algorithm: table-fill with 8x manual unrolling per chunk
; Fill mem[0..n] with fib values, then output mem[n]
; Unrolled inner body: each chunk computes 8 consecutive fib values
; R0 = n
; R1 = modulus
; R2 = current index i (starts at 2)
; R3 = fib(i-2)
; R4 = fib(i-1)
; R5 = fib(i) temp
; R6 = chunk end index
; R7 = temp

    IN R0
    MOV R1, 1000000007

    ; Base: mem[0]=0 already, mem[1]=1
    JZ R0, EMIT_ZERO

    MOV R7, 0
    STOR R7, [R7+0]       ; mem[0] = 0
    MOV R7, 1
    STOR R7, [R7+0]       ; mem[1] = 1

    MOV R7, 1
    JLE R0, R7, EMIT_ONE

    ; n >= 2
    ; Initialize R3=fib(0)=0, R4=fib(1)=1, i=2
    MOV R3, 0
    MOV R4, 1
    MOV R2, 2

CHUNK_START:
    ; If i > n, done filling
    JGT R2, R0, DONE_FILL

    ; Compute chunk end = min(i+7, n), store in R6
    MOV R6, R2
    ADD R6, 7
    JLE R6, R0, DO_CHUNK
    MOV R6, R0            ; clamp to n

DO_CHUNK:
    ; We'll do up to 8 steps manually, checking i<=R6 each time

    ; Step 1
    JGT R2, R6, CHUNK_START
    MOV R5, R3
    ADD R5, R4
    MOD R5, R1
    STOR R5, [R2+0]
    MOV R3, R4
    MOV R4, R5

    ; Step 2
    JGT R2, R6, CHUNK_START
    MOV R5, R3
    ADD R5, R4
    MOD R5, R1
    STOR R5, [R2+0]
    MOV R3, R4
    MOV R4, R5

    ; Step 3
    JGT R2, R6, CHUNK_START
    MOV R5, R3

    MOD R5, R1
    STOR R5, [R2+0]
    MOV R3, R4
    MOV R4, R5

    ; Step 4
    JGT R2, R6, CHUNK_START
    MOV R5, R3
    ADD R5, R4
    MOD R5, R1
    STOR R5, [R2+0]
    MOV R3, R4
    MOV R4, R5
    INC R2

    ; Step 5
    JGT R2, R6, CHUNK_START
    MOV R5, R3
    ADD R5, R4
    MOD R5, R1
    STOR R5, [R2+0]
    MOV R3, R4
    MOV R4, R5

    ; Step 6
    JGT R2, R6, CHUNK_START

    ADD R5, R4
    MOD R5, R1

DONE_FILL:

    IN R0          ; R0 = n (array length)
    
    ; Read array into memory starting at address 0
    CLR R1         ; R1 = index counter

    JGE R1, R0, READ_DONE
    IN R2
    STOR R2, [R1+0]

BSEARCH:
    ; if low > high, not found
    JGT R4, R5, NOT_FOUND
    
    ; mid = (low + high) / 2
    MOV R6, R4
    ADD R6, R5
    DIV R6, 2     ; R6 = mid

    JLT R7, R3, GO_RIGHT

    MOV R5, R6
    DEC R5
    JMP BSEARCH

; Exponential Search + Binary Search
; Phase 1: Gallop/double index until arr[bound] >= target or bound >= n
; Phase 2: Binary search in [bound/2, min(bound, n-1)]
;
; Registers during gallop:
;   R0 = n
;   R1 = target
;   R2 = base address (2000)
;   R3 = bound (current gallop index, starts at 1)
;   R4 = arr[bound]
;   R5 = temp address
;   R6 = lo (for binary search phase)
;   R7 = hi (for binary search phase)

    IN R0           ; R0 = n
    MOV R2, 2000    ; base address

    ; Read array into mem[2000..2000+n-1]
    CLR R5          ; index counter
READ_LOOP:
    JGE R5, R0, READ_DONE
    IN R4
    MOV R3, R2
    ADD R3, R5
    STOR R4, [R3+0]
    INC R5
    JMP READ_LOOP
READ_DONE:

    IN R1           ; R1 = target

    ; Handle empty array
    JZ R0, NOT_FOUND

    ; Check index 0 first
    LOAD R4, [R2+0]
    MOV R5, R4
    SUB R5, R1
    JZ R5, FOUND_ZERO

    ; If arr[0] > target, not found (array is sorted)
    JGT R4, R1, NOT_FOUND

    ; Exponential gallop: bound starts at 1
    MOV R3, 1       ; R3 = bound

GALLOP:
    ; if bound >= n, cap and go to binary search
    JGE R3, R0, CAP_AND_SEARCH

    ; load arr[bound]
    MOV R5, R2
    ADD R5, R3
    LOAD R4, [R5+0] ; R4 = arr[bound]

    ; if arr[bound] == target => found
    MOV R5, R4
    SUB R5, R1
    JZ R5, FOUND_BOUND

    ; if arr[bound] >= target => stop galloping, binary search [bound/2, bound]
    JGE R4, R1, DO_BSEARCH

    ; double the bound
    MUL R3, 2
    JMP GALLOP

CAP_AND_SEARCH:
    ; bound >= n, so hi = n-1, lo = bound/2
    MOV R7, R0
    DEC R7          ; hi = n - 1
    MOV R6, R3
    DIV R6, 2       ; lo = bound / 2
    JMP BSEARCH

DO_BSEARCH:
    ; binary search in [bound/2, bound]
    MOV R7, R3      ; hi = bound
    DIV R3, 2       ; R3 = bound/2
    MOV R6, R3      ; lo = bound/2
    JMP BSEARCH

BSEARCH:
    ; lo = R6, hi = R7
    ; if lo > hi => not found
    JGT R6, R7, NOT_FOUND

    ; mid = lo + (hi - lo) / 2
    MOV R5, R7
    SUB R5, R6      ; R5 = hi - lo
    DIV R5, 2       ; R5 = (hi-lo)/2
    ADD R5, R6      ; R5 = mid

    ; load arr[mid]
    MOV R3, R2
    ADD R3, R5
    LOAD R4, [R3+0] ; R4 = arr[mid]

    ; if arr[mid] == target => output mid
    MOV R3, R4
    SUB R3, R1
    JZ R3, FOUND_MID

    ; if arr[mid] < target => lo = mid + 1
    JLT R4, R1, RIGHT

    ; else hi = mid - 1
    MOV R7, R5
    DEC R7
    JMP BSEARCH

RIGHT:
    MOV R6, R5
    INC R6
    JMP BSEARCH

FOUND_ZERO:
    OUT 0
    HALT

FOUND_BOUND:
    OUT R3
    HALT

FOUND_MID:
    OUT R5
    HALT

NOT_FOUND:
    OUT -1
    HALT

    ; if low > high, not found
    JGT R4, R5, NOT_FOUND
    
    ; mid = (low + high) / 2
    MOV R6, R4
    ADD R6, R5
    DIV R6, 2     ; R6 = mid
    
    ; load arr[mid]
    LOAD R7, [R6+0]
    
    ; if arr[mid] == target, found
    MOV R1, R7
    SUB R1, R3
    JZ R1, FOUND
    
    ; if arr[mid] < target, low = mid + 1
    JLT R7, R3, GO_RIGHT
    
    ; else high = mid - 1
    MOV R5, R6
    DEC R5
    JMP BSEARCH
    
GO_RIGHT:
    MOV R4, R6
    INC R4
    JMP BSEARCH
    
FOUND:
    OUT R6
    HALT
    
NOT_FOUND:
    OUT -1
    HALT

; Binary search using a different structure:
; Store array at base address 1000
; Use a "converging pointers" style where we track lo and hi
; and compute mid differently (lo + (hi-lo)/2)
; Registers:
;   R0 = n
;   R1 = loop counter for reading
;   R2 = base address (1000)
;   R3 = target
;   R4 = lo
;   R5 = hi
;   R6 = mid
;   R7 = temp

    IN R0           ; R0 = n
    MOV R2, 1000    ; base address for array storage

    ; Read array into mem[1000..1000+n-1]
    CLR R1
LOAD_LOOP:
    JGE R1, R0, LOAD_DONE
    IN R7
    ADD R7, R2      ; address = base + index... wait, need to store differently
    ; Actually store: mem[1000 + R1] = value
    ; Use R6 as address
    MOV R6, R2
    ADD R6, R1
    ; R7 currently holds address, need value
    ; Redo: use a different temp
    SUB R7, R2      ; restore R7 to value (undo the add)
    ; Let me use a cleaner approach
    ; R7 = value (just read), R6 = address
    STOR R7, [R6+0]
    INC R1
    JMP LOAD_LOOP
LOAD_DONE:

    IN R3           ; R3 = target

    ; lo = 0, hi = n - 1
    CLR R4
    MOV R5, R0
    DEC R5

    ; Check empty array
    JLT R5, R4, NOT_FOUND

BSEARCH:
    ; if lo > hi => not found
    JGT R4, R5, NOT_FOUND

    ; mid = lo + (hi - lo) / 2
    MOV R6, R5
    SUB R6, R4      ; R6 = hi - lo
    DIV R6, 2       ; R6 = (hi - lo) / 2
    ADD R6, R4      ; R6 = lo + (hi - lo) / 2  => mid

    ; load arr[mid] = mem[base + mid]
    MOV R1, R2
    ADD R1, R6      ; R1 = address of arr[mid]
    LOAD R7, [R1+0] ; R7 = arr[mid]

    ; compare arr[mid] with target
    ; if arr[mid] == target => found
    MOV R1, R7
    SUB R1, R3
    JZ R1, FOUND

    ; if arr[mid] < target => lo = mid + 1
    JLT R7, R3, MOVE_LO

    ; else arr[mid] > target => hi = mid - 1
    MOV R5, R6
    DEC R5
    JMP BSEARCH

MOVE_LO:
    MOV R4, R6
    INC R4
    JMP BSEARCH

FOUND:
    OUT R6
    HALT

NOT_FOUND:
    OUT -1
    HALT

; Binary search - iterative with different register usage and loop structure
; Strategy: use a "half-open interval" [lo, hi) where hi = n initially
; This avoids the n-1 initialization and changes the termination condition
; Array stored at base address 500
; Registers:
;   R0 = n (also used as hi, half-open upper bound)
;   R1 = lo (starts at 0)
;   R2 = target
;   R3 = base address (500)
;   R4 = mid (index)
;   R5 = address of arr[mid]
;   R6 = arr[mid] value
;   R7 = temp for comparisons

    ; Read n
    IN R0
    MOV R3, 500     ; base address

    ; Read array elements into mem[500..500+n-1]
    CLR R7          ; R7 = loop index
FILL:
    JGE R7, R0, FILL_DONE
    IN R6
    MOV R5, R3
    ADD R5, R7      ; address = 500 + index
    STOR R6, [R5+0]
    INC R7
    JMP FILL
FILL_DONE:

    ; Read target
    IN R2

    ; Binary search on half-open interval [lo, hi)
    ; lo = R1 = 0, hi = R0 = n
    CLR R1          ; lo = 0
    ; R0 already = n = hi

SEARCH:
    ; if lo >= hi => not found
    JGE R1, R0, NOT_FOUND

    ; mid = lo + (hi - lo) / 2
    MOV R4, R0
    SUB R4, R1      ; R4 = hi - lo
    DIV R4, 2       ; R4 = (hi - lo) / 2
    ADD R4, R1      ; R4 = mid

    ; load arr[mid]
    MOV R5, R3
    ADD R5, R4      ; R5 = 500 + mid
    LOAD R6, [R5+0] ; R6 = arr[mid]

    ; if arr[mid] == target => found
    MOV R7, R6
    SUB R7, R2
    JZ R7, FOUND

    ; if arr[mid] < target => lo = mid + 1
    JLT R6, R2, GO_RIGHT

    ; else arr[mid] > target => hi = mid (half-open: hi = mid, not mid-1)
    MOV R0, R4
    JMP SEARCH

GO_RIGHT:
    MOV R1, R4
    INC R1          ; lo = mid + 1
    JMP SEARCH

FOUND:
    OUT R4
    HALT

NOT_FOUND:
    OUT -1
    HALT

; Exponential Search + Binary Search
; Phase 1: Gallop/double index until arr[bound] >= target or bound >= n
; Phase 2: Binary search in [bound/2, min(bound, n-1)]
;
; Registers during gallop:
;   R0 = n
;   R1 = target
;   R2 = base address (2000)
;   R3 = bound (current gallop index, starts at 1)
;   R4 = arr[bound]
;   R5 = temp address
;   R6 = lo (for binary search phase)
;   R7 = hi (for binary search phase)

    IN R0           ; R0 = n
    MOV R2, 2000    ; base address

    ; Read array into mem[2000..2000+n-1]
    CLR R5          ; index counter
READ_LOOP:
    JGE R5, R0, READ_DONE
    IN R4
    MOV R3, R2
    ADD R3, R5
    STOR R4, [R3+0]
    INC R5
    JMP READ_LOOP
READ_DONE:

    IN R1           ; R1 = target

    ; Handle empty array
    JZ R0, NOT_FOUND

    ; Check index 0 first
    LOAD R4, [R2+0]
    MOV R5, R4
    SUB R5, R1
    JZ R5, FOUND_ZERO

    ; If arr[0] > target, not found (array is sorted)
    JGT R4, R1, NOT_FOUND

    ; Exponential gallop: bound starts at 1
    MOV R3, 1       ; R3 = bound

GALLOP:
    ; if bound >= n, cap and go to binary search
    JGE R3, R0, CAP_AND_SEARCH

    ; load arr[bound]
    MOV R5, R2
    ADD R5, R3
    LOAD R4, [R5+0] ; R4 = arr[bound]

    ; if arr[bound] == target => found
    MOV R5, R4
    SUB R5, R1
    JZ R5, FOUND_BOUND

    ; if arr[bound] >= target => stop galloping, binary search [bound/2, bound]
    JGE R4, R1, DO_BSEARCH

    ; double the bound
    MUL R3, 2
    JMP GALLOP

CAP_AND_SEARCH:
    ; bound >= n, so hi = n-1, lo = bound/2
    MOV R7, R0
    DEC R7          ; hi = n - 1
    MOV R6, R3
    DIV R6, 2       ; lo = bound / 2
    JMP BSEARCH

DO_BSEARCH:
    ; binary search in [bound/2, bound]
    MOV R7, R3      ; hi = bound
    DIV R3, 2       ; R3 = bound/2
    MOV R6, R3      ; lo = bound/2
    JMP BSEARCH

BSEARCH:
    ; lo = R6, hi = R7
    ; if lo > hi => not found
    JGT R6, R7, NOT_FOUND

    ; mid = lo + (hi - lo) / 2
    MOV R5, R7
    SUB R5, R6      ; R5 = hi - lo
    DIV R5, 2       ; R5 = (hi-lo)/2
    ADD R5, R6      ; R5 = mid

    ; load arr[mid]
    MOV R3, R2
    ADD R3, R5
    LOAD R4, [R3+0] ; R4 = arr[mid]

    ; if arr[mid] == target => output mid
    MOV R3, R4
    SUB R3, R1
    JZ R3, FOUND_MID

    ; if arr[mid] < target => lo = mid + 1
    JLT R4, R1, RIGHT

    ; else hi = mid - 1
    MOV R7, R5
    DEC R7
    JMP BSEARCH

RIGHT:
    MOV R6, R5
    INC R6
    JMP BSEARCH

FOUND_ZERO:
    OUT 0
    HALT

FOUND_BOUND:
    OUT R3
    HALT

FOUND_MID:
    OUT R5
    HALT

NOT_FOUND:
    OUT -1
    HALT

; Interpolation Search + fallback Binary Search
; Uses interpolation formula: mid = lo + (target - arr[lo]) * (hi - lo) / (arr[hi] - arr[lo])
; Falls back to binary search when arr[hi] == arr[lo]
; Array stored at base address 3000
;
; Registers:
;   R0 = n
;   R1 = target
;   R2 = base address (3000)
;   R3 = lo
;   R4 = hi
;   R5 = mid (computed index)
;   R6 = arr[mid] or temp
;   R7 = temp

    IN R0           ; R0 = n
    MOV R2, 3000    ; base address

    ; Read array into mem[3000..3000+n-1]
    CLR R7          ; index counter
READLOOP:
    JGE R7, R0, READDONE
    IN R6
    MOV R5, R2
    ADD R5, R7
    STOR R6, [R5+0]
    INC R7
    JMP READLOOP
READDONE:

    IN R1           ; R1 = target

    ; Handle n == 0
    JZ R0, NOTFOUND

    ; lo = 0, hi = n - 1
    CLR R3
    MOV R4, R0
    DEC R4

ISEARCH:
    ; if lo > hi => not found
    JGT R3, R4, NOTFOUND

    ; load arr[lo]
    MOV R5, R2
    ADD R5, R3
    LOAD R6, [R5+0]   ; R6 = arr[lo]

    ; if target < arr[lo] => not found
    JLT R1, R6, NOTFOUND

    ; load arr[hi]
    MOV R5, R2
    ADD R5, R4
    LOAD R7, [R5+0]   ; R7 = arr[hi]

    ; if target > arr[hi] => not found
    JGT R1, R7, NOTFOUND

    ; if arr[lo] == arr[hi], check equality then binary search or decide
    MOV R5, R7
    SUB R5, R6         ; R5 = arr[hi] - arr[lo]
    JZ R5, EQUALRANGE

    ; Interpolation: mid = lo + (target - arr[lo]) * (hi - lo) / (arr[hi] - arr[lo])
    ; Compute numerator: (target - arr[lo]) * (hi - lo)
    ; Use R6 as (target - arr[lo]), R7 as (hi - lo), R5 as denominator
    ; denominator = arr[hi] - arr[lo] (already in R5)
    ; Save denominator somewhere: store in mem[2999]
    STOR R5, [R2-1]    ; mem[2999] = arr[hi] - arr[lo]

    MOV R6, R1
    SUB R6, R6         ; reset - redo
    ; reload arr[lo]
    MOV R5, R2
    ADD R5, R3
    LOAD R6, [R5+0]    ; R6 = arr[lo]

    MOV R5, R1
    SUB R5, R6         ; R5 = target - arr[lo]

    MOV R6, R4
    SUB R6, R3         ; R6 = hi - lo

    MUL R5, R6         ; R5 = (target - arr[lo]) * (hi - lo)

    LOAD R7, [R2-1]    ; R7 = arr[hi] - arr[lo]
    DIV R5, R7         ; R5 = numerator / denominator

    ADD R5, R3         ; R5 = mid = lo + ...

    ; Clamp mid to [lo, hi]
    JGE R5, R3, CLAMP_HI
    MOV R5, R3
CLAMP_HI:
    JLE R5, R4, MID_OK
    MOV R5, R4
MID_OK:

    ; load arr[mid]
    MOV R6, R2
    ADD R6, R5
    LOAD R6, [R6+0]    ; R6 = arr[mid]

    ; compare with target
    MOV R7, R6
    SUB R7, R1
    JZ R7, FOUND

    JLT R6, R1, GORIGHT

    ; arr[mid] > target => hi = mid - 1
    MOV R4, R5
    DEC R4
    JMP ISEARCH

GORIGHT:
    ; arr[mid] < target => lo = mid + 1
    MOV R3, R5
    INC R3
    JMP ISEARCH

EQUALRANGE:
    ; arr[lo] == arr[hi], check if target matches
    MOV R5, R6
    SUB R5, R1
    JZ R5, FOUND_LO
    JMP NOTFOUND

FOUND_LO:
    OUT R3
    HALT

FOUND:
    OUT R5
    HALT

NOTFOUND:
    OUT -1
    HALT

; Two-pointer linear scan from both ends simultaneously
; Registers:
;   R0 = n
;   R1 = target
;   R2 = left pointer (starts at 0, advances forward)
;   R3 = right pointer (starts at n-1, advances backward)
;   R4 = value at left
;   R5 = value at right
;   R6 = temp
;   R7 = base address (100)

    IN R0           ; R0 = n
    MOV R7, 100     ; base address

    ; Handle n == 0
    JZ R0, NOTFOUND

    ; Read array into mem[100..100+n-1]
    CLR R6          ; index counter
READLOOP:
    JGE R6, R0, READDONE
    IN R4
    MOV R5, R7
    ADD R5, R6
    STOR R4, [R5+0]
    INC R6
    JMP READLOOP
READDONE:

    IN R1           ; R1 = target

    ; left = 0, right = n - 1
    CLR R2
    MOV R3, R0
    DEC R3

SCANLOOP:
    ; if left > right, not found
    JGT R2, R3, NOTFOUND

    ; Check if left == right (single element remaining)
    MOV R6, R2
    SUB R6, R3
    JZ R6, SINGLE

    ; Load arr[left]
    MOV R6, R7
    ADD R6, R2
    LOAD R4, [R6+0]     ; R4 = arr[left]

    ; Check if arr[left] == target
    MOV R6, R4
    SUB R6, R1
    JZ R6, FOUND_LEFT

    ; Load arr[right]
    MOV R6, R7
    ADD R6, R3
    LOAD R5, [R6+0]     ; R5 = arr[right]

    ; Check if arr[right] == target
    MOV R6, R5
    SUB R6, R1
    JZ R6, FOUND_RIGHT

    ; Since array is sorted:
    ; if arr[left] > target, target cannot exist (all remaining >= arr[left] > target... wait sorted ascending)
    ; arr[left] <= arr[left+1] <= ... <= arr[right]
    ; if arr[left] > target => not found
    JGT R4, R1, NOTFOUND

    ; if arr[right] < target => not found
    JLT R5, R1, NOTFOUND

    ; arr[left] < target and arr[right] > target
    ; advance both pointers inward
    INC R2
    DEC R3
    JMP SCANLOOP

SINGLE:
    ; left == right, check that element
    MOV R6, R7
    ADD R6, R2
    LOAD R4, [R6+0]
    MOV R6, R4
    SUB R6, R1
    JZ R6, FOUND_LEFT
    JMP NOTFOUND

FOUND_LEFT:
    OUT R2
    HALT

FOUND_RIGHT:
    OUT R3
    HALT

NOTFOUND:
    OUT -1
    HALT

; Jump Search (Block Search)
; Phase 1: Jump forward by block_size = floor(sqrt(n)) steps until arr[block_end] >= target
; Phase 2: Linear scan backward from block_end to find exact index
; Array stored at base address 4000
;
; Registers:
;   R0 = n
;   R1 = target
;   R2 = base address (4000)
;   R3 = block_size (approx sqrt(n))
;   R4 = current jump position (block_end)
;   R5 = value at current position
;   R6 = linear scan index
;   R7 = temp / address

    IN R0           ; R0 = n
    MOV R2, 4000    ; base address

    ; Handle n == 0
    JZ R0, NOTFOUND

    ; Read array into mem[4000..4000+n-1]
    CLR R7
READLOOP:
    JGE R7, R0, READDONE
    IN R5
    MOV R4, R2
    ADD R4, R7
    STOR R5, [R4+0]
    INC R7
    JMP READLOOP
READDONE:

    IN R1           ; R1 = target

    ; Compute block_size = floor(sqrt(n)) using integer sqrt
    ; Use iterative method: find largest k such that k*k <= n
    CLR R3          ; R3 = k = 0
SQRTLOOP:
    MOV R7, R3
    INC R7          ; R7 = k+1
    MOV R4, R7
    MUL R4, R7      ; R4 = (k+1)^2
    JGT R4, R0, SQRTDONE
    INC R3
    JMP SQRTLOOP
SQRTDONE:
    ; R3 = floor(sqrt(n)), ensure at least 1
    JNZ R3, BLOCKSIZE_OK
    MOV R3, 1
BLOCKSIZE_OK:

    ; Jump search phase
    ; current position starts at block_size - 1 (end of first block)
    ; prev = 0 (start of current block)
    ; R4 = current jump end index
    MOV R4, R3
    DEC R4          ; R4 = block_size - 1

JUMPLOOP:
    ; Clamp R4 to n-1
    MOV R7, R0
    DEC R7          ; R7 = n-1
    JLE R4, R7, NO_CLAMP
    MOV R4, R7
NO_CLAMP:

    ; Load arr[R4]
    MOV R5, R2
    ADD R5, R4
    LOAD R5, [R5+0] ; R5 = arr[R4]

    ; If arr[R4] < target, jump to next block
    JLT R5, R1, NEXT_BLOCK

    ; arr[R4] >= target: do linear scan backward from R4
    JMP LINSCAN

NEXT_BLOCK:
    ; Check if we've reached the end
    MOV R7, R0
    DEC R7
    MOV R6, R4      ; save current position as prev block start hint
    JGE R4, R7, NOTFOUND

    ; Advance R4 by block_size
    ADD R4, R3
    JMP JUMPLOOP

LINSCAN:
    ; Linear scan from R4 down to find target
    ; R6 = scan index, starts at R4
    MOV R6, R4

SCANLOOP:
    ; if R6 < 0, not found
    JLT R6, 0, NOTFOUND

    ; Load arr[R6]
    MOV R7, R2
    ADD R7, R6
    LOAD R5, [R7+0] ; R5 = arr[R6]

    ; if arr[R6] == target => found
    MOV R7, R5
    SUB R7, R1
    JZ R7, FOUND

    ; if arr[R6] < target => target not in array (we passed it)
    JLT R5, R1, NOTFOUND

    ; arr[R6] > target, keep scanning left
    DEC R6
    JMP SCANLOOP

FOUND:
    OUT R6
    HALT

NOTFOUND:
    OUT -1
    HALT
